usageNotes: Use this to discover ZFS pools that already exist on a node's local disks before adding them as Proxmox storage. The node must be online and have ZFS kernel modules loaded; pools that are not imported will not appear in the results. Requires Datastore.Allocate on /storage, so API tokens used for storage provisioning workflows will have the necessary privilege.

examples.summary: List all ZFS pools available on node pve1

tips: Only imported (active) ZFS pools are returned — unimported pools or pools on offline disks will not appear.
Run this before calling the storage-create endpoint to confirm the pool name exists and is spelled correctly.
If no pools are returned but you expect some, verify ZFS is loaded on the node: `zpool list` via SSH will confirm the local view.
